title: Spanish Verb Ir Practice: Forms, Ir a + Infinitive and Quiz
description: Practice the Spanish verb ir: present and preterite forms, ir a for future plans, ten questions that correct themselves and a short reading. Free, no login.
intro: Ir means «to go» and it is completely irregular. It also builds the most useful future in Spanish: ir a + infinitive. Learn the forms, see the uses and practice with instant feedback.

demand.source: Google autocomplete for US searchers (hl=en, gl=us), docs/seo-plan/us1000/suggest-us-20261127.csv

uses.example: Voy a la escuela en autobús.
uses.meaning: I go to school by bus.

uses.example: Vamos a ver una película esta noche.
uses.meaning: We are going to watch a movie tonight.

uses.use: How you travel: ir en + transport
uses.example: Mi padre va al trabajo en tren.
uses.meaning: My dad goes to work by train.

uses.example: El verano pasado fuimos a Cancún.
uses.meaning: Last summer we went to Cancún.

quiz.why: A plan with nosotros: vamos a + infinitive.
A + la stays a la; only a + el becomes al.

quiz.after: a la fiesta de Marta el viernes pasado?

reading.titleEs: Planes para el fin de semana
paragraphs: El viernes por la tarde, Daniela y sus amigos hablan de sus planes. Daniela va a ir al partido de béisbol con su papá, porque juegan los Astros. Su amigo Óscar no va a salir: va a quedarse en casa y va a terminar un proyecto de historia.

Las gemelas, Sara y Lucía, van al centro comercial el sábado por la mañana y después van a comer con su abuela. «¿Y el domingo?», pregunta Daniela. «Vamos todos a la playa», dice Óscar. «El domingo pasado fuimos al lago y fue muy aburrido.»

comprehension.why: With her dad, to see the Astros.

comprehension.before: Sara y Lucía van a comer con
El domingo pasado los amigos fueron

mistakes.why: A + el always contracts to al.
Ir a is followed by the infinitive.
Destination takes a; en is for the means of transport (en autobús).

heritage: For heritage speakers, the challenge with ir is spelling. Write «vamos» and «van» with v, and «iba» and «íbamos» (imperfect) with b; «íbamos» also needs an accent. «Fuistes» is common in speech but the written form is fuiste. Write about a family trip using fui, fuimos and fueron.
teacher: Teachers: ir a + infinitive gives students a future tense on day one. After the reading, students write three plans for the weekend and then interview each other with «¿Qué vas a hacer el sábado?». The reading also models the contraction al.

figure.text: On 27 November 2026, Google suggested 10 searches to people in the United States who typed «spanish verb ir». 5 of them ask for conjugation, charts or tenses (conjugation, conjugation chart, in the future tense, past tense, present tense). 1 asks for practice (to go worksheet pdf). Several of them ask about the future and the past of ir, so the forms chart shows both the present and the preterite, and ir a + infinitive.
